subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “One does not seem heavy, but many together can fill a bottle.”?
options: They are pictures of time, knowledge, and change.
Time can be lost in pieces before anyone notices.
Both need time, care, and someone willing to begin.
A living classroom changes every time students enter it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「They are pictures of time, knowledge, and change.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「One does not seem heavy, but many together can fill a bottle. Time can be lost in pieces before anyone notices.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「One does not seem heavy, but many together can fill a bottle. Time can be lost in pieces before anyone notices.」，答案為「Time can be lost in pieces before anyone notices.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Time can be lost in pieces before anyone notices.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
